चम् (-उ, न) चम्नोति 5.
a. To eat; to
chew. With आ prefixed, to sip.

चम-त्कार (रः) 1.
m. Surprise; spec-
tacle; a riot; name of tree.

चम-त्कारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Sur-
prising, astonishing.

चम-त्कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Astonished.

चम-त्कृति (तिः) 2.
f. Spectacle. &c.

चमर (रं) 1.
n. The
chauri used to
wisk off flies, &c.
m. f. Bos grun-
niens.
f. Compound pedicle.

चामर (रं-रा) 1.
n. f. A
chaurī.

चमर-पुच्छ (च्छः) 1.
m. Animal with
bushtail; a squirrel.
n. Chauri.

चमरिक (कः) 1.
m. A species of ebony.

चमस (सः-सी) 1.
m. 3.
f. A sacrificial
ladle; kind of sweetmeat or cake.

चमू (मूः) 3.
f. An army, a squadron,
129 elephants, 129 cars, 2187
horse, 3615 foot.

चमू-चर (रः) 1.
m. A soldier.

चमू-पति (तिः) 2.
m. A general.

चमूरु (रुः) 2.
m. A kind of deer.

चम्पचम्पति 1.
a. To go or move.

चम्प (म्पः) 1.
m. Mountain ebony.
f.
The capital of
Karna, Bāgulpur.

चम्पक (कः) 1.
m. Michelia cham-
paca; a division of the jack fruit;
the
champa flower of plantain.

चम्पका-लु (लुः) 1.
m. The bread-fruit
tree (Artocarpus integrifolio).

चम्प-कोष (षः) 1.
m. Idem.

चम्पा-धिप (पः) 1.
m. A name of
Karna.

चम्पा-पुरी (री) 3.
f. The city
Champā.

f. The district of
Champā or
Bāgulpur.

चम्पू (म्पूः) 3.
f. A work of prose
and verse, intermixed.

चम्पेश (शः) 1.
m. Karna, the na-
OK^1 brother of the
Pandus.
